verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It double-counts permutations whose initial segment is a member of the antichain to derive the Lubell-type inequality, proves that the middle binomial coefficient is maximal, obtains the stated upper bound, and verifies that the family of all floor(n/2)-element subsets attains equality. The argument covers the endpoint sizes and all positive integers n, uses the antichain hypothesis correctly, and contains no prohibited or externally dependent justification.
